section.content: 一种半导体集成电路，包括后备存储器(14)、DMA控制部(21)及WDT(监控定时器)(22)。DMA控制部21在CPU(11)处于正常动作WDT(22)接收到计数器复位信号(CR)时，将CPU(11)、RAM(12)及周边电路(13)的各种数据保存到后备存储器(14)中，并且当由WDT(22)检测出程序超限而输出超时信号(TO)时，将保存在后备存储器(14)中的数据分别恢复到CPU(11)、RAM(12)及周边电路(13)中。从而解决了当发生程序超限时对CPU实施复位后会返回初始状态，从初始状态再执行程序会失去中途的数据的问题，实现了即使发生所述程序超限时也可以从该程序的中途开始重新正常动作。

A backup memory, a DMA (direct memory access) controller, and a WDT (watch dog timer) are provided. The DMA controller exercises control so that respective data of the CPU, RAM and peripheral circuit is saved in the backup memory each time the CPU, being under normal operation, supplies a counter reset signal to the WDT, and so that the data that has been saved in the backup memory is restored to the CPU, the RAM and the peripheral circuit, respectively, if the WDT has detected a program runaway and outputted a time-over signal. Therefore, even in a case where a program runaway has occurred in the CPU, normal operation is permitted to be resumed from midway in the program.

SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit)Technical field

The present invention relates to have the control module of stored program system, the SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) of for example processor.

Background technology

In Japanese patent laid-open 6-131218 communique, disclose a kind of supervision timer (Watch Dog timer:WDT) that utilizes and implemented the CPU control technology that resets as detection computations machine system exception and to processor (CPU).WDT monitors the counter reset signal by the regular output of CPU, when not having the counter reset signal input in during regulation when transfiniting owing to program, exports timeout signal.According to this WDT timeout signal CPU is implemented to reset, make it can recover normal state.

But, in the above-mentioned prior art, after CPU being implemented to reset according to timeout signal because of making it get back to original state, so can be from beginning rerun routine at first, consequently the data till midway are not used.

Summary of the invention

The objective of the invention is to, though produced that transfiniting also of program can be from this program begin to reenter regular event midway.

In order to achieve the above object, SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) of the present invention comprises: the control module of stored program system; Be used to deposit the backing store of preserving data; Be used for detecting the pick-up unit that transfinites that described control module program transfinites; And realize by control, data with this control module when described control module regular event are saved in the described backing store, and return in the described control module when detecting the data that will be kept at when described program transfinites in the described backing store, data transfer controller.

When also comprising: when having at least one other circuit module of data store, described data transfer controller also has: realize by control, data with described other circuit module when described control module regular event are saved in the described backing store, and return in described other circuit module when detecting the data that will be kept at when described program transfinites in the described backing store, function.

Embodiment

Below, with reference to accompanying drawing embodiments of the invention are described.

Fig. 1 is the figure of the configuration example of expression SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) of the present invention.In Fig. 1, the 11st, CPU, the 12nd, RAM, the 13rd, peripheral circuit, the 14th, backing store.CPU11 is the control module of the stored program system of moving according to the program that is kept among the not shown ROM.RAM12 is used to store CPU11 move and required memory of data.Peripheral circuit 13 is the input and output portions with various functions such as serial communication, analog/digital conversion.Backing store 14 is to preserve: the programmable counter of CPU11 and the significant data D1 that various register had that comprises status register; Significant data D2 in whole storage data of RAM12; And the significant data D3 in the various inputs of the peripheral circuit 13 deletion total datas that control register had, storer.These CPU11, RAM12, peripheral circuit 13 and backing store 14 interconnect through CPU path 16.

The semiconductor circuit of Fig. 1 also has: the DMA control part 21 that is used to control the direct memory access action; WDT (supervision timer) 22; And recovery mark 15.

WDT22 monitors the counter reset signal CR by the regular output of CPU11, when not having counter reset signal CR input in during regulation when transfiniting owing to program, exports timeout signal TO.

DMA control part 21, be to realize: when obtaining during from the counter reset signal CR of WDT22 at the CPU11 regular event by control, above-mentioned data D1, D2 and D3 are saved in the backing store 14, and, when the WDT22 program of detecting transfinites and timeout signal TO when output arranged, the data that are kept in the backing store 14 are returned to CPU11, RAM12 and peripheral circuit 13 respectively, data transfer controller.

C1 among Fig. 1 is the read/write signal that CPU11 uses, and C2 is the RAM12 read/write signal, and C3 is that peripheral circuit 13 is used read/write signal, and C4 is that backing store 14 is used read/write signal.For example, when being saved in the data D1 of CPU11 in the backing store 14, specifying with signal C1 and to read action, write action with signal C4 appointment, read action and specify with signal C4 will be kept at data in the backing store 14 and return among the CPU11 time, write action with signal C1 appointment.

Recovering mark 15, is to be used for that this information is moved in the recovery of finishing data by the control of DMA control part 21 to be delivered to the mark of CPU11.C5 recovers mark 15 to use write signal, according to it mark 15 is set.This recovery mark 15 is reset when CPU11 reads.

According to having the SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) of Fig. 1 of above-mentioned formation, minimum desired data D1, D2 and D3 with this SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) when the CPU regular event are saved in the backing store 14, and the data that will be kept at respectively when the WDT22 program of detecting transfinites in the backing store 14 are recovered, thereby, even also can be when former thereby generating routine transfinites because of extraneous interference etc. from this program begin regular event again midway.That is to say, be not to return to normal state by homing action, but can return to that internal state constantly of having finished regular event of this SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit).

And, by the required significant data of saving/restoring minimum only, can reduce and preserve and recover required time, also can reduce the capacity of backing store 14.

In addition and since be provided be used for will implement the data information of recovering action be delivered to the recovery mark 15 of CPU11, mark 15 is recovered by checking in the back so CPU11 restarts, and can discern program has taken place to transfinite.Therefore, undertaken obtaining data once more from the outside or calculate again and realize the chance of the correction of internal state by carrying out the repair procedure of preparing at this situation, can passing.

But also can be the total data in CPU11, RAM12 and the peripheral circuit 13 as the object of preserving and recovering.At this moment, because of the normal internal state of this SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) can restore fully, so just do not need above-mentioned recovery mark 15.

In addition, DMA control part 21 preserving in data and the process by these backing store 14 restore data to backing store 14, can make the action of this CPU11 stop by signal C1 is provided to CPU11 as the CPU stop signal.Like this, can prevent in the preservation of carrying out data or rejuvenation because of the program mistake that causes that transfinites writes, thereby can improve the reliability of data.

In addition, backing store 14 also can be a nonvolatile memory.Like this, even power supply is cut off, the data in the backing store 14 also can keep, thus help behind the power up from program begin midway restart.Only when the preservation of carrying out data and recovery, provide power supply also passable to backing store 14.In addition, backing store 14 also can be the external hanging type storer of this SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit).

Fig. 2 is the figure of another configuration example of expression SIC (semiconductor integrated circuit) of the present invention.As shown in Figure 2, backing store 14, the backing store dedicated path 17 through being different from CPU path 16 is connected with DMA control part 21, and the CPU11 hypothesis is not visited the authority of backing store 14.Like this, when transfiniting, the program of CPU11 can prevent that this CPU11 mistake will be kept at replacing in the backing store 14.Others are identical with the formation of Fig. 1.

Fig. 3 is the block scheme of configuration example of recovery control part of the variation of presentation graphs 1 and Fig. 2.The recovery control part of Fig. 3 is made of event counter 31 and timer 32.Event counter 31 is by counting the quantity of timeout signal TO, thereby realizes the counting to the number of times that transfinited by the detected program of WDT22.When the count value of this event counter 31 arrives setting and produces when overflowing, CPU stops request signal SA and is sent to DMA control part 21 and timer 32.Timer 32 receives this CPU to be stopped behind the request signal SA being provided to DMA control part 21 through CPU being stopped to remove request signal SB after during certain.DMA control part 21 keeps CPU stop signal C1 after recovering release when obtaining CPU and stop request signal SA, cancellation CPU stop signal C1 is so that move CPU11 again when obtaining CPU and stop to remove request signal SB.Like this, recovering action back program when implementation data repeatedly transfinites when still continuing, forcibly make the action of CPU11 stop certain during, and restart again after waiting the reason elimination of transfiniting.In addition, event counter 31 and timer 32 are respectively by the counter reset signal CR zero clearing of representing the CPU11 regular event.

In addition, in above-mentioned each example, though be that the counter reset signal CR of WDT22 will be provided the clock signal as the data preservation, but also can pick the multiple various moment such as picking the moment of makeing mistakes in the moment, the serial communication, carry out the preservation of data at the rewriting moment of important registers such as status register, the execution moment, the noise that the moment, particular command take place in interruption.As the example of the interruption that mentions here, the interruption that the time of can enumerating interrupts, taken place during the analog digital conversion, from the external interrupt of other microcomputer etc.

In sum, according to the present invention, data with this control module when the control module regular event of stored program system are saved in the backing store, and the data that will be kept at when the program of detecting transfinites in the backing store return in this control module, thereby, even the generation program transfinite also can be from this program begin regular event again midway.
